faq

Can I particpate?

Any teenager ages 13-18 (under 19) can participate in Keyframe!

What if I can't code?

You can read the guides in the docs!

How many projects can I submit?

As many as you'd like!

How long can I spend drawing?

Art can make up 25% of a project's total working time.

You can track as many hours as you'd like making art, but the time working will be deflated.

Can I submit my project to another Hack Club program?

Keyframe doesn't allow double dipping, sorry!

Can I submit team projects?

No, sorry! You can only submit your own work to Keyframe.

When does Keyframe end?

Keyframe runs from September 10, 2026 to September 15, 2026- though it may be extended!

I have more questions!

Ask a question in #keyframe or #code!
